description: A white square base with round corner sockets sits on a green mat, with one rectangular white post already standing upright near the back and a second loose rectangular piece to the right. The left hand stays planted on the base to steady it while the right hand picks up the loose rectangular piece, moves it leftward over the front-right socket, lowers it into the socket, and makes small adjustments—tilting and pressing down—to seat the post upright before easing off.
